businessModel: Free browser; agent mode for ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscribers
paidNote: Agent mode limited to Plus and Pro (while running)
summary: OpenAI's macOS-only AI browser launched Oct 21, 2025 with a ChatGPT sidebar, browser memories and agent mode. OpenAI announced retirement Jul 9, 2026 and stopped it Aug 9, 2026, folding features into ChatGPT desktop and Codex.
bestFor: Anyone migrating data (export window has closed)

pros.title: Deep ChatGPT integration
pros.detail: Sidebar chat, cursor chat and browser memories were native.

pros.title: Agent mode
pros.detail: Could complete tasks like hotel booking for Plus/Pro users.

pros.title: Memory controls
pros.detail: OpenAI said memory summaries were deleted within seven days; training on browsing off by default.

cons.title: Shut down
cons.detail: Stopped working Aug 9, 2026, under a year after launch.

cons.title: Data not transferable
cons.detail: Bookmarks, history and tabs did not move automatically; export window closed.

cons.title: macOS only
cons.detail: Windows, iOS and Android were announced but not confirmed shipped.

cons.title: Security findings
cons.detail: LayerX reported a memory-injection attack in Oct 2025; OpenAI said it could not reproduce it.

faq.a: No. It stopped working on Aug 9, 2026; chatgpt.com/atlas now loads standard ChatGPT.
OpenAI lead James Sun said core capabilities moved into the redesigned ChatGPT desktop app; OpenAI gave no further explanation.
Data not exported before the window closed cannot be recovered.

timeline.event: OpenAI announces merging Atlas, ChatGPT desktop and Codex

switching.note: No longer installable. See comet, dia or opera-neon.

jsSpeed: Blink/V8 engine, Chrome-class JS speed; no vendor benchmark
pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
startup: Chromium cold start, heavier than plain Chrome
memory: Chromium multi-process plus AI layer; RAM-heavy
cpu: Chromium-class; agent tasks add background load
lowEnd: Needs modern hardware; AI features add load
installSize: Full Chromium bundle, a few hundred MB
privacyDefaults: Opt-in memories, training off by default; cloud AI
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
behaviourCustom: Few shortcut or per-site options documented
tabManagement: Tab groups and search; no workspaces documented
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
productivity: Sidebar chat, cursor chat, agent mode
translation: AI-driven page translation; no dedicated engine
extras: AI agent and memory; no VPN or wallet
sync: ChatGPT account memories; no browser sync
accessibility: Chromium accessibility stack, unverified for AI layer
businessTrust: Killed in under a year; data not recoverable
ai: Full ChatGPT agent and memory at peak

featureNotes.adBlocker: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026
